artworks.title: Soldier Taking Aim [recto]
artworks.medium: black and white chalk over graphite on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a man in full body profile, standing and facing left. He is holding a long rifle to his shoulder, aiming to the left, with his elbows bent and the rifle secured against his right shoulder. The man's facial features and hair are not detailed, but he appears to be wearing a cap. He is dressed in a jacket, pants, and shoes. The setting appears outdoors, indicated by lines on the ground suggesting vegetation or uneven terrain. The background is plain, emphasizing the focus on the man in the foreground.

artworks.title: Skirmish Involving a Wagon Train [verso]
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horse-drawn wagons and figures traversing a landscape. The drawing is done in pencil on a textured surface, featuring horses pulling covered wagons and figures managing them. The background shows more wagons, hinting at a larger group. The lower part of the composition is less detailed, with the main focus on the upper part where the action takes place. The expressive line work conveys movement and rugged terrain.

artworks.title: Zouave
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on olive-green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a slightly leaning forward position with their head lowered, looking downwards. They have facial features that are somewhat shadowed, with a mustache visible. The person wears a cloth wrapping or turban around their head with long draping ends falling down their back. They are dressed in traditional clothing, which includes a loose, long-sleeved top and baggy trousers that taper at the ankles with wrappings over what appear to be boots or shoes. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Henry Clay
artworks.medium: graphite with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing depicting a person from the shoulders up, facing forward with a slight left angle. This individual is an older man with features like a prominent forehead, thinning hair, deep-set eyes, a long nose, a firm mouth, noticeable cheekbones, and a slightly angular chin. The hair is short and combed back. The man is dressed in what looks like a suit or formal attire with a high collar, and there is a cravat or scarf around his neck. The drawing is in a monochrome style with shading for contours, and the plain background shows the paper texture. No jewelry or objects are visible on the subject.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white chalk on brown  wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a profile drawing of a woman's head and part of her shoulders. She is facing to the right, with defining facial features and hair styled in an updo. The woman appears to be wearing a high-collared garment with delicate detailing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Study of a Woman's Dress
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk heightened with white chalk on pink wove paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Avalon Fund
artworks.description: This is an unfinished sketch showing a partial view of a person's upper body. The drawing features the torso area with details of clothing, including a dress with a deep collar, gathered fabric at the shoulders, and a sash tied in a bow at the front. The background is a plain, light-colored paper with no additional elements. The face, hair, and any jewelry or objects are not illustrated.

artworks.title: Studies of a Lion's Head
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. John Steiner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three lion heads. The artwork features detailed sketches of lions' heads, drawn with brown ink and fine lines. Each lion is depicted with its mane flowing around its face, with intricate line work capturing the texture of their fur. The expressions of the lions convey a sense of strength and majesty, each depicted from different angles—one from the side, another in a slightly upward facing orientation, and the last lying down. The use of line and shading gives the drawing a dynamic quality.

artworks.title: Standard Bearer
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gouache and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. John Steiner
artworks.description: The image shows a man in full armor standing upright, facing the viewer. He wears a green tabard over the armor, with intricate designs. The man has a beard and shoulder-length hair. He appears neutral with prominent eyes. In his right hand, he holds a pole with a striped banner featuring a tree motif. His left hand grasps a shield with a similar emblem. The armor is detailed with metallic and gold highlights, circular decorations on the knees and shoulders. A sword hangs from his belt. In the background, there is a pinkish hue and green and brown foliage elements on the ground. A helmet with a tree motif rests beside him.

artworks.title: The Young Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in sepia-ochre, olive and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image portrays a figure shown from the waist up, seated in a slightly reclined position with their head tilted back and gazing upwards. The person's facial features are detailed with distinct shadowing, and they have wavy hair that is swept back from the face. They are draped in a patterned fabric covering one shoulder, holding an object resembling a staff adorned with ribbons in one hand and a ring on a finger of the other hand. Surrounding them are elements of nature, including foliage and what appears to be a sheep nestled against them. The background is filled with etched lines suggesting a wooded setting with trees, shrubbery, and sketches of birds in flight overhead.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Nicolo Vicentino, after Giovanni Antonio Pordenone
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure entangled in an abstract setting. The artwork portrays a muscular, humanoid figure with detailed, feathered wings extending from its back. The figure is in a dynamic pose, with one arm bent upward and the other supporting its body while partially reclining. The environment around the figure seems abstract with stark contrasts of light and dark areas, creating a dramatic effect. Textures are emphasized, particularly in the figure's musculature and the shading of the wings. The style suggests a dramatic and expressive approach, reminiscent of high-contrast woodcut or etching techniques.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Nicolo Vicentino, after Giovanni Antonio Pordenone
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological figure reclining with symbolic elements. The figure appears muscular and partially winged, positioned with a dynamic posture, facing towards the left. The drawing displays intricate detailing in the body's musculature and wings. An object resembling a scythe is present. The overall tone is monochromatic, utilizing various shades of browns and reds. The background provides minimal context, focusing attention on the central figure.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Nicolo Vicentino, after Giovanni Antonio Pordenone
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular, winged being reclining on the ground. The being is seated with one knee raised, supporting themselves on their left arm while the right arm is raised above their head. They have long, flowing hair, a strong profile, and detailed musculature. Wings extend from their back. In the background, there is a shadowy figure holding a set of scales in the right hand and draping the left hand over the shoulder of the primary figure. The setting is a simple, textured surface in soft, monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: Bull
artworks.description: The image displays a side view of a large cow standing close, taking up much of the scene. The horizon is low in the distance with a small structure and trees against the sky. A second cow is standing and a third lying on the ground further away. Detailed line work defines the texture of the cow's fur and the landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of brown and beige. Sparse branches and leaves hang from the top as subtle details against the sky.

artworks.title: A Cow Standing and Another Lying Down
artworks.description: The image shows a view from ground level of two cows in a field. One cow is standing on the left, looking at the viewer, while the other is reclining on the grass to the right. The horizon is near the top with faint indications of a distant landscape. The illustration is detailed with fine linework using hatching and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrasts.

artworks.title: Cow Lying Down near a Fence
artworks.description: This is an image of a cow lying next to a fence. The cow is resting on a slightly elevated patch of ground, with its front legs tucked beneath its body and its head slightly lowered. The cow's fur texture and shadows accentuate its form. It has prominent horns and calm eyes. A wooden fence is to the right, showing signs of age. In the background, there are faint horizontal lines suggesting a landscape with trees or bushes. The sky is minimally detailed with a bird flying in the distance. The linework creates a tranquil rural scene.

artworks.title: Grazing Cow
artworks.description: The image shows two cows in a rural setting. One cow is standing and grazing in the center, while another cow is lying down to the left under a tree. In the background, there is a church spire on the right. The black and white etching features detailed lines to create texture and depth in the scene, with a clear sky above.

artworks.title: Standing Cow (Cow with a Crumpled Horn)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cow in a pastoral landscape. The cow is shown with crosshatching for texture and musculature details on its flank and neck. Its head is slightly lowered, with shadow details rendered intricately. Beside the cow are vegetation and a fallen tree log. The background includes open fields with a small structure in the distance. The line work is precise and detailed, adding to the rustic and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Pissing Cow
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a cow on the right and two sheep on the left. The horizon is low, with some buildings and trees far in the distance. The animals are detailed with fine lines, creating a textured look. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white shades for depth and form, with shadows and texture created by cross-hatching. Birds are flying in the sky above the rural scene.

artworks.title: Two Oxen Fighting
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cows grazing in a pasture. The image features two cows positioned with their heads down, suggesting they are grazing or interacting with the ground. The cows have carefully detailed body structure and fur texture. The background shows some trees on the horizon line and a clear sky. The drawing is created using detailed line work and shading to give depth and dimension, creating a serene and pastoral atmosphere. The scene conveys a sense of rural tranquility and simplicity.

artworks.title: Two Cows Seen from Behind
artworks.description: Two large cows, one standing and the other lying down next to a wooden fence. The image is rendered in black ink with detailed linework. The standing cow is on the left facing away, while the lying cow is on the right facing right. In the background, some small human figures are walking towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Odysseus and Teiresias
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 24.6 x 41.5 cm (9 11/16 x 16 5/16 in.)
support: 33.8 x 50.4 cm (13 5/16 x 19 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and creatures in a dramatic scene. The image shows a group of figures interacting, with some appearing to be in conflict. In the forefront, two figures are engaged in physical struggle, surrounded by other figures in various postures. The setting is an ambiguous cavernous environment with distant figures and rocky formations. The medium used is likely ink and wash, with a limited color palette.

artworks.title: Figures (Christ Calling One of the Apostles?)
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing featuring several figures in a natural and architectural setting. It shows three figures dressed in flowing garments around a central tree, with a structure resembling an arch in the background. The drawing is done in a soft, sketchy style emphasizing movement and interaction, with shadows and outlines providing depth and dimension.

artworks.title: Venus as a Huntress Appearing to Aeneas and Achates
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper, traces of red chalk upper left
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical figures and a cherub. The drawing depicts several figures in classical attire. The central figures are engaged in an interaction, with one pointing towards a cherub or putto floating above them. The composition is lively, with fluid lines and an expressive portrayal of motion. The surrounding environment includes loosely sketched foliage.

artworks.title: Venus Appearing to Achilles
artworks.description: The image is an intricate drawing of a classical scene with three figures beneath a tree. The figures are shown standing and wearing various classical garments. One figure holds a spear, another gazes upwards, and the third has a raised arm. A cherub-like figure with wings is shown in movement above them, along with a child supported by foliage. The facial features are delicately drawn, and the scene is set outdoors with tree foliage and clouds. The composition is enclosed within an oval frame with Latin inscriptions below it.
